shellCommands.command: git status --short; ls -la; cat package.json; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100

for f in pages/*.js pages/*/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js components/*.js styles/* next.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; git diff package.json; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ node_modules/next/dist/docs/*
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; ls 02-guides | head -80; ls 02-guides/migrating; ls 03-api-reference/*; cat ../../../package.json | grep '"version"'

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; sed -n 1,80p 02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md; grep -n -i "default" 03-api-reference/04-functions/fetch.md | head -20; ls 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config; grep -rn "retry" ../../../dist/client/components/error-boundary.d.ts | head; grep -rn "ErrorInfo\|export type" ../../../types/*.d.ts ../../../dist/client/components/error-boundary.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd node_modules/next; sed -n 1,40p dist/client/components/error-boundary.d.ts; cat dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/index.md | head -60; sed -n 80,140p dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; grep -n -i "metadata\|client" 03-file-conventions/not-found.md | head; sed -n 1,60p 04-functions/generate-metadata.md | grep -n "Props\|params" ; grep -n "PageProps\|params" 04-functions/generate-static-params.md | head; curl -sS -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1; curl -sS -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter
rm -rf pages components/AppProvider.js && npx next typegen >/dev/null 2>&1; npx tsc --noEmit; echo tsc=$?; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40
rm app/blog/\[id\]/loading.tsx && npx next build 2>&1 | grep -E "error|Error|✓ Compiled"
b=http://localhost:3124; for p in /blog/1 /blog/50 /blog/99999 /nope; do echo "$p $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' $b$p)"; done; curl -s $b/blog/99999 | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>'
